candidate.title: disqus:import regresses to live HTTP fetch per thread with no error handling (and drops -c category option), causing imports to abort or mis-categorize
reports: the disqus import loop now performs network i/o with no rescue: topicembed.importremote(user, t[:link], ...) inside parser.threads.each means a single 404 or timeout on an old export permalink aborts the entire cli run partway through.

p2: disqus:import task drops the public category/-c option and changes behavior to synchronous remote http fetch (topicembed.importremote), breaking existing scripted invocations and raising on unreachable links where imports previously succeeded

[bug] the disqus import now performs a live http fetch per thread via topicembed.importremote with no error handling, where the previous implementation created posts locally with no network dependency. one dead, redirecting or slow link raises openuri::httperror and aborts the entire import mid-run, leaving a partial import with no resume path.

breaking cli contract change: the --category/-c thor option was removed from the disqus importer, so existing invocations passing -c fail on thor's unknown-option check and imported topics silently lose category assignment and original createdat preservation; the importer also switched to live-fetching thread urls via topicembed.importremote, silently skipping dead or non-http links instead of importing them
